question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_needed
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
    GROUP BY product_id
),
inv_with_sort AS (
    SELECT inv.id, inv.product_id, inv.qty as inv_qty, inv.location_id, inv.purchase_id, loc.warehouse, loc.aisle, loc.position, p.purchased, p.qty as purchase_qty
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN locations loc ON inv.location_id = loc.id
    JOIN purchases p ON inv.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE loc.warehouse = 1
      AND inv.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_lines)
),
ranked_inv AS (
    SELECT i.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY i.purchased ASC, i.inv_qty ASC) as rn
    FROM inv_with_sort i
),
picking AS (
    SELECT r.product_id, r.location_id, r.aisle, r.position, r.inv_qty, r.purchased, r.purchase_qty,
           o.total_needed,
           SUM(r.inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY r.product_id ORDER BY r.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_available
    FROM ranked_inv r
    JOIN order_lines o ON r.product_id = o.product_id
),
with_qty AS (
    SELECT product_id, location_id, aisle, position, inv_qty as available_qty, cumulative_available,
           CASE 
               WHEN cumulative_available - inv_qty < total_needed THEN
                   LEAST(inv_qty, total_needed - (cumulative_available - inv_qty))
               ELSE 0
           END as qty_to_pick
    FROM picking
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, available_qty, qty_to_pick
FROM with_qty
WHERE qty_to_pick > 0
ORDER BY product_id, location_id

{"sql": "WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_needed
    FROM orderlines

),
inv_with_sort AS (
    SELECT inv.id, inv.product_id, inv.qty as inv_qty, inv.location_id, inv.purchase_id, loc.warehouse, loc.aisle, loc.position, p.purchased, p.qty as purchase_qty
    FROM inventory inv

    JOIN purchases p ON inv.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE loc.warehouse = 1
      AND inv.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_lines)
),
ranked_inv AS (
    SELECT i.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY i.purchased ASC, i.inv_qty ASC) as rn
    FROM inv_with_sort i
),
picking AS (
    SELECT r.product_id, r.location_id, r.aisle, r.position, r.inv_qty, r.purchased, r.purchase_qty,
           o.total_needed,
           SUM(r.inv_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY r.product_id ORDER BY r.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_available,
           SUM(o.total_needed) OVER (PARTITION BY r.product_id ORDER BY r.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_needed,
           o.total_needed as order_total
    FROM ranked_inv r
    JOIN order_lines o ON r.product_id = o.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, location_id, aisle, position, inv_qty as available_qty, purchased, purchase_qty, order_total, cumulative_available, order_total - (cumulative_available - inv_qty) as qty_to_pick
FROM picking
